thread:
tara_cs: customer reported 401s ~10m after we rotated their API key in Vault. calls from an S3 Lambda to /v1/generate failing.

lina_support: any correlation id or sample response?

tara_cs: curl response body: \u003cHTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\u003e {"error":"invalid_api_key"} header x-request-id: req_abc123. Lambda logs show environment still has OLD_KEY in process env on warm containers.

sam_engineer: can you share the rotation steps? did CI update env and restart lambda or just write to SSM/param store?

tara_cs: flow was: Vault `secret/data/apikeys/acme` -> new version 5. CI writes to SSM /services/acme/API_KEY (overwrite) and triggers a config job but the job only updates parameter store, not `update-function-configuration`. we *also* have a vault-agent sidecar that syncs to /etc/secrets/acme but the file there stayed at old value on some hosts.

rik_devops: reproduced in staging — warm lambda containers keep old key until cold start. but I also saw vault-agent errors on the host.

kevin_infra: paste the agent log lines?

tara_cs: `vault-agent [ERROR] 2026-03-17T15:12:01Z write /etc/secrets/acme failed: permission denied (os error 13)`

lina_support: that looks like EACCES. who owns /etc/secrets on the host? any tmp cleanup jobs?

sam_engineer: on some nodes `/etc/secrets` got chown'ed to root:root (mode 0755) by a tmpfile/cleanup at 03:00. vault-agent writes via atomic write -> tmp + rename; if it can't write tmp it fails. our rotate-apply CI assumes sidecar will always succeed.

rik_devops: quick workaround for customer: force a cold start (redeploy or increase memory to force new container) + restart vault-agent sidecar on the affected hosts. that should pick up new key.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1972 (apikey-hot-swap-acme) Priority: P2

kevin_infra: root cause summary: system tmpfile cleanup changed dir ownership/perm which blocked vault-agent atomic write -> sidecar never updated secret file -> warm Lambdas continued serving using OLDKEY -> 401s after Vault rotation. also potential KMS alias rotate hazard but not seen in logs for this run.

tara_cs: did the customer confirm success after quick workaround?

lina_support: customer says requests succeeded after we restarted vault-agent + triggered lambda redeploy. they saw no further 401s.

sam_engineer: actions: 1) Add chown step to rotate-apply CI to ensure vault-agent can write (sam) 2) Hardening: sidecar should retry on EACCES and fall back to non-atomic write then rename (rik) 3) Console: surface secret write failures as tenant alerts (kevin) 4) Postmortem + KB with runbook (lina)

lina_support: I'll add owners and ETA (48h for code + 72h for console surfacing). I'll update INC-2026-1972 and ping acme-corp with summary.

sam_engineer: quick commands for ops (if you need to run manually):
```
# fix perms then restart sidecar
sudo chown appuser:appgroup /etc/secrets && sudo chmod 0750 /etc/secrets
kubectl -n acme rollout restart deploy/vault-agent-acme
# force lambda cold start (option A) - update env var deliberate noop
aws lambda update-function-configuration --function-name acme-proxy --description "coldstart-$(date +%s)"
```

rik_devops: noted. will also check if our tmpfile config is overwriting /etc/secrets on periodic cleanup and add an exception.

vault-agent: autopost: wrote heartbeat failure metric to metrics.ingest: vault.agent.write_failures{tenant="acme"} 1

tara_cs: closing loop — customer is unblocked. we'll follow up with PMs to get permanent fix rolled out. :white_check_mark:
